content:
clara: quick heads-up from azalea-v1 int6 onboarding: noticeable drop on vertical ruby + mixed-RTL samples. baseline fp16 BLEU=32.4 -> azalea-int6 BLEU=28.0 on vertical_ruby_mixed_eval. also a handful of mirrored brackets and broken ZWJ sequences.

yuto: ouch. can you paste the eval command and raw numbers?

clara: ran on ci-evals:
```
python tools/eval_translate.py --model=azalea-v1:quant=int6 --testset=data/vertical_ruby_mixed.jsonl --metrics=bleu,chrf,exact_match --batch=48
```
metrics: azalea-int6 BLEU=28.0 chrF=44.0 EM=0.60 | baseline-fp16 BLEU=32.4 chrF=49.2 EM=0.67. eval-bot: automated-diff {"bleu":"-4.4","chrf":"-5.2"} (p<0.01).

ryan: minimal failing example? tokenization vs detok ordering?

clara: short sample (src / ref / azalea-int6):
src: "日本記録　(注)》اب"
ref: "日本記録　(注)」参考اب"
azalea-int6: "日本記録　(注参)》اب"
issue: parenthetical moved and closing bracket changed to fullwidth close-angle at mixed-RTL boundary. also saw "😊‍❤️" split in a few outputs.

zhen: token_map unchanged for quant build. runtime enabled prefix-coalesce + early-kv-trim for int6. suspect coalesce/detok running before bidi reflow -> punctuation gets reattached to wrong side.

yuto: i'll run two quick variants on bench-mini: (A) int6 + detok-after-bidi, (B) int6 + prefix-coalesce-disabled. also adding 15 human-inspect samples to ci/regress/azalea_vertical_manual.jsonl (PR #4999).

eval-bot: queued smoke subset: azalea-int6-sub BLEU=28.3 -> baseline-sub BLEU=32.1.

ryan: if variant A recovers most of the gap we should move detok after bidi for all orientation-sensitive flows. short-term: gate prefix-coalesce by locale/orientation. longer-term: make coalesce bidi-aware and grapheme-cluster safe.

clara: action items: 1) yuto run variants + post hashes and sample diffs; 2) zhen audit detok + bidi ordering and grep for zenkaku/ZWJ handlers; 3) ryan add unit tests for RTL-bracket + ZWJ sequences and blockroll for int6 until fixes. tagging: P1 onboard; escalate to P0 if full eval still degrades. please drop outputs here, thx :pray:
